exact_target: For every integer d >= 4, a complex affine integral Poisson algebra of Krull dimension d has a maximal-spectrum symplectic core that is not locally closed.
essential_import: BLLSM Theorem 4.1; the differential-algebraic existence theorem is not independently reproved.
reconstructed_steps: Poisson conversion A=R[t] with dim R=d-1 and dim A=d
Fraction-field Poisson center and zero intersection of nonzero Poisson primes
Density of each primitive maximal-spectrum core
Exact local-closedness bridge and maximal-spectrum PDME equivalence
source_caveat: LWW arXiv:1908.06542v2 Theorem 6.7(ii) has an overbroad all-prime clause, contradicted by zero-bracket C[x]. The supported maximal-spectrum route uses Proposition 5.3 and Lemma 6.5. No such wording is attributed to the uninspected journal body.

related_problem.relationship: Adjacent unrestricted PDME question reconciled by the same equivalence; no separate new result claimed.

review_status: AI-assisted exposition and independent internal AI audit; authored documents are unrefereed.
